column1: # Known slow calls: our per-call cost against Metal's, where it is over an order of magnitude.
# READ THIS BEFORE ADDING A ROW. A row here is not an accepted difference and it is not permission
# for anything. It is a call that costs an order of magnitude more than Metal's over the cases both
# legs did exactly, written down so the one call that holds an open bug visible does not make every
# run red and teach everyone to stop reading the report. Nothing here is resolved by being listed.
# The gate is held in BOTH directions (src/slow_calls.rs): a call over the margin that is not
# listed fails the run, and a listed call that has come back inside the band fails it too, saying
# the row looks fixed and must go. So a row cannot outlive the bug it stands for.
# Before adding a row, LOCALISE IT: `conformance times --runs 8 --call <name>` prints the call case
# by case. A per-call total says that a call is expensive and never where, and the first row below
# was 105x over the whole set and 1.2x over the three cases that obviously make it.
# A ratio here is a measurement and it moves: over two whole-set runs of one binary on this M3 Max,
# Metal's own per-call totals moved a median 1.28x and as much as 2.43x. That is why the margin is
# an order of magnitude and why a listed row is only read as fixed below the band (margin / 2.5).
# Fields, tab-separated:
#   call                the Side call
#   mode                the shader-cache mode it was measured in: warm or cold. A row is held ONLY
#                       in its own mode, because `compute_pipeline` is 8.2x Metal's warm and 53.0x
#                       cold, and one row for both would read a mode change as a fix.
#   measured            the ratio its measurement read, with an x
#   where the cost is   the family it is in, and what the figure splits into
#   waiting on          what Metal does, what we do instead, and where the fix belongs
replace_region
column4: all of it in the 16 xr-two-plane-samples cases: one replaceRegion each, Metal 4 us against our 1210 us, 92% of ours blocked; the other 86 cases that make the call are 1.3x together
column5: Metal's replaceRegion on a two-plane extended-range texture answers in 4 us; ours waits about 1.1 ms, so we stage the upload and wait on it where Metal writes through. The fix is in the runtime's texture upload path for two-plane extended-range formats, not in the suite

column1: render_pipeline
column4: 85 calls over the comparable set, Metal 5459 us against our 181742 us, of which 168004 us is our own CPU
column5: Pipeline creation is CPU work we do and Metal does differently; AGENTS.md gives pipeline-creation time its own ceiling rather than the device API's, so this row records the size of the gap and is NOT yet attributed. It is unaudited: the alone-versus-in-set contrast has not been run on it

column1: render_pipeline_with_reflection
column4: one call, Metal 291 us against our 4274 us, 3946 us of it our own CPU
column5: The same pipeline-creation path as render_pipeline plus reflection; listed separately because one call is too thin a measurement to fold into that row

column1: tile_pipeline
column4: three calls, Metal 192 us against our 2292 us, all of it our own CPU
column5: The same pipeline-creation path for tile pipelines. Closest of the four to the band, so a quiet run may read it either side; the band exists for exactly this row

column1: compute_pipeline
column4: twelve comparable cases over eight rounds, Metal 1044 us against our 55335 us, 52854 us of it our own CPU; the same selection warm is 8.2x, so cold costs us 5.9x what warm does
column5: Cold, our compute-pipeline creation is 53x Metal's. Metal front-loads the compile to newLibraryWithData (24 ms a call) and we back-load it to pipeline creation, so our total compile path is still 4.7x cheaper than Metal's cold -- but per call this is where our cost is, and warm hides 5.9x of it behind shader reuse. The fix belongs in the translator and pipeline-creation path, which AGENTS.md gives its own ceiling

column1: render_pipeline
column4: four calls over the same twelve cases, Metal 554 us against our 25301 us, 24168 us of it our own CPU; the same selection warm is 14.0x, so cold costs us 3.3x what warm does
column5: The same pipeline-creation path as compute_pipeline cold. Listed in both modes because the gap is large in both and the two figures are different measurements
